summary.intent: Run the full autonomous post-execution ship pipeline for GSD Phase 68 (verify → secure → validate → simplify → SDK E2E gate → CodeRabbit review → ship → resolve PR reviews → extract learnings) on the cipher-box repo, then triage a fresh batch of CodeRabbit comments that landed on the already-open PR #587.
summary.outcome: Phase 68 was fully shipped as PR #587 with all gates green (security 41/41 closed, validation 0 gaps, SDK E2E 12/12, CodeRabbit and Greptile findings triaged/fixed/deferred, all review threads resolved, learnings extracted), and a subsequent fresh batch of CodeRabbit findings (SDK high-water validation, UX opts threading, IDB version pinning, new tests) was fixed, tested, and committed, ready to push after a fetch/rebase.

repo: CI's Test job only runs vitest for api/crypto/core/sdk-core/sdk/api-client — apps/web vitest is never executed in CI, so failures there (e.g. ipns.service.test.ts) don't block ship
`gh pr edit` fails on this repo due to Projects-classic GraphQL incompatibility — PR body edits must go through `gh api -X PATCH repos/FSM1/cipher-box/pulls/<N> -F body=@file`
apps/api's `TEE_WORKER_URL` defaults to `http://localhost:3001`, which locally is mock-ipns-routing, not the real tee-worker (:3002) — causes silent TEE test failures unless overridden
Read plane is keyed by `ipnsName` alone (no separate node id, per SealedChildRef contract); write plane is keyed by UUID — CodeRabbit findings assuming inconsistent keying were false positives
D-09 zeroization terminal-owner rule: a callee must never zero caller-owned buffers — violating this class of bug caused a historical 48/89 E2E break in Phase 51
`github-actions[bot]` pushes a `chore(release)` commit to the branch after `gh pr create` and after a passing Release Preview — always `git fetch` + rebase before the next push or it's rejected
root `pnpm typecheck` excludes `apps/api` tsc — pre-existing spec errors there (ipns-verify-cache.spec.ts, http-metrics.interceptor.spec.ts) are outside all CI gates
sdk-e2e has 11 v1 suites `describe.skip`-quarantined since PR #578 (v2 cutover) — these skips are expected, not phase regressions
SentShareResponseDto intentionally has no plaintext `itemName` field — a CodeRabbit finding claiming data loss there was a false positive

code.finding: enumerateMoveDescendants zeroed the parent readKey in a finally block before the children loop finished using it to unseal — misclassified every depth-2+ move descendant as unreadable. Fixed by restructuring try/finally so the key outlives the children walk, verified with a red-green regression test.

updateGrant needed to be wrapped in a DB transaction with a pessimistic write lock plus a `BigInt(rootGeneration) < BigInt(share.rootGeneration)` check to reject rootGeneration regressions atomically (anti-rollback guard); no existing service-level tests covered updateGrant, 5 new spec cases added.
idbPut needed to become max-preserving within a single readwrite transaction (get existing → Math.max → put) to avoid regressing the durable generation/sequence floors.

workflow: A background task notification reporting 'exit code 0' can still mask a real test failure if output is piped through `tail` — always read the actual captured output file before trusting the summary
Red-green verification (temporarily revert a fix, confirm the new test fails, then reinstate) is an effective way to prove a regression test actually catches the bug it targets

Delegating large, self-contained artifact-mining work (e.g. learnings extraction across 24 plan/summary docs) to a subagent keeps the orchestrator's context free while the answer streams back structured

Sandboxed Bash can silently block `gh` network calls (`dial tcp i/o timeout`), producing false 'settled' polling results when empty strings are compared as equal — rerun with sandbox disabled for any PR-check polling

Triage findings against an explicit fix-now-vs-defer rule (in-scope+low-risk fix immediately; pre-existing/out-of-domain/risky → todo with file refs) keeps a long autonomous review loop from stalling on judgment calls

friction: First SDK E2E run appeared to pass (exit 0) but actually had a TEE lease-renewer test timeout, requiring deep tracing (BullMQ queue state, container logs, compose file, rebuild) to discover a stale tee-worker container running a pre-Phase-67 contract
TEE_WORKER_URL environment default mismatch (:3001 vs :3002) caused a second round of SDK E2E failure after the first fix

ipns.service.test.ts failure required extensive investigation (diffing against main, tracing import chains, swapping in main's file) before confirming it was pre-existing and outside CI, not a phase regression
Edit tool repeatedly failed with 'File modified since read' during commit windows because lint-staged/linters mutated files concurrently — required re-reading and re-applying edits
zsh quirks: bare `echo ===X===` misinterpreted as a command; working directory persisting into apps/api broke relative paths, requiring absolute paths/repo-root cd
Session hit its usage limit mid-poll, requiring a bare 'continue' from the user to resume
commit helper occasionally reports commit_failed while the commit actually lands, requiring manual `git log` verification instead of blind retries
